mechanism_narrative: A sustained four-week rise in TRANSIT mobility indicates restored commuting and errand trips, lifting retail-and-recreation footfall so RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is less than or equal to its last-28-day mean despite TRANSIT rising for four consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility recovering from -66.3 to -60.4 in two weeks signals employees returning to offices, which increases weekday retail and recreation spending, pushing RETAIL_REC up over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES continues rising but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean does not exceed its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility crosses above -65 after being below -65 in the prior week, it signals a seasonal shift to outdoor activity that spills over into nearby retail and recreation, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -65 after being below -65 in the prior week
failure_condition: PARKS crosses above -65 but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES move together in a reopening regime; their joint recovery multiplies retail footfall because commuting enables both workday and leisure shopping, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise week-on-week, RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean fails to exceed its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-reopening regime where RESIDENTIAL falls below 39 while TRANSIT rises above -65, people substitute home time for out-of-home retail, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL below 39 and TRANSIT above -65 occur, yet RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not higher than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM stabilization at -20.7 for two weeks indicates essential-trip demand has plateaued, freeing household time and spending for retail and recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM changes by less than 1 point week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM plateaus for two weeks but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL remains above 38.5, stay-at-home behavior continues to suppress out-of-home retail trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 38.5 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above 38.5 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than or equal to its last-28-day mean.
